issues.reason: NuGet declares MIT; pinned upstream LICENSE is LGPL 2.1, documentation contains LGPL 3, and managed source headers grant Library GPL version 2 or later. No sole-MIT conclusion is approved.
issues.resolution: Record authoritative clarification or an explicitly reviewed LGPL distribution basis, preserving the applicable notices and all embedded component rights.
issues.question: Which grants apply to each included part, and what documented basis permits distributing their combination?

issues.reason: Archived original CodeProject article and linked license page establish CPOL 1.02 for Brian Duke's DBF code. Compatibility with the upstream LGPL distribution and permission for MIT/LGPL relicensing remain unconfirmed.
issues.resolution: Preserve CPOL 1.02 and Brian Duke attribution; establish a valid compatible distribution basis, obtain additional permission, or replace the affected implementation with code of verified compatible provenance.
issues.question: Can the incorporated CPOL 1.02 DBF code be distributed within this LGPL library under the documented grants, or is additional permission or replacement needed?
